name: Neural Model Training for Atlas Baking
definition: A 2D surfel rasterizer with a hash-grid and MLP appearance model, used to train a neural model from which the texture atlas is baked. One configuration is used for every scene.
summary: Neural Model Training for Atlas Baking configures the hash-grid and MLP to learn view-dependent residual colors, distinguished by providing the specific hyperparameters and schedule required before baking the model into a static spatial atlas.
